topic: Stripe acquires OpenRouter for $7B — the agent economy just got a payment rail (and it isn't open)
tweet_text:
stripe bought openrouter for $7B.

$1.3B → $7B in 3 months.

every AI agent you've ever built routes through this layer.

the agent economy just got a payment rail — and it isn't open.

your move.

#ai #agents
concept: A single pair of converging metallic railroad tracks vanishing into a dark void — one rail glowing molten gold (Stripe/payment), the other glowing electric cyan (OpenRouter/agent network), meeting at a brilliant vanishing point. Literalizes 'rails' (Stripe), the convergence of two infrastructures (the deal), the velocity implied by a 5x valuation step-up, and the closed rail the agent economy now runs on.
alt_text: Two converging metallic railroad tracks vanishing into a dark void, one glowing molten gold and the other glowing electric cyan, meeting at a bright vanishing point — a visual metaphor for Stripe's acquisition of OpenRouter.
